mediaWork.title: In the Dark
mediaWork.focusOrTheme: Long-form investigative journalism into prosecutorial misconduct, flawed investigations, and wrongful convictions (notably Season 2 on Curtis Flowers).
mediaWork.summaryNotes: Peabody Award-winning investigative journalism podcast hosted by Madeleine Baran (originally APM Reports, now The New Yorker). Season 2 deeply investigated the six trials of Curtis Flowers in Winona, Mississippi—uncovering racial jury discrimination and recanted jailhouse-informant testimony that helped lead to a U.S. Supreme Court ruling and Flowers's eventual exoneration.
